description:
Identify and prove the M4RI operation that is mathematically and operationally comparable with one dense mid-range consumer.

## Background

Existing M4RI evidence covers transpose and BCH-generator framing, neither of which substitutes for dense `BitMatrix::matvec`. A useful comparator must match a real consuming operation and charge construction, conversion, execution, and output costs.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A committed operation-match specification pins the M4RI revision, license, build flags, exact operation, dimensions, representation mapping, output semantics, and reproducible commands.
- [hard] REQ-02: A semantic probe demonstrates an equivalent dense consumer result with adapter costs identified, or records with evidence that no matched M4RI operation exists within the declared search budget.

## Notes

Grounding: `dev/active/2037941f-profile-and-optimize-mid-range-buffer-operations/investigation.md` and the linked Zen 3 measurement contract.
title: Qualify a matched M4RI consumer operation
